outputQuantity.name: cell_average_depth
outputQuantity.definition: Water volume divided by full grid-cell area; not road or channel depth

assumptions: Catchment-aligned 2021 terrain with verified 2023 edge; published roughness/CN scenario; seven directed free-outflow cells
Explicit dry assumed state at antecedent start followed by supplied analysis discharge and observed rainfall; continuous state into forecast
Initial state is assumed; equilibrium not established.
NWM13Z and HRRR14Z original forecasts; no current-weather refresh.
Depth reconstructed using existing SFINCS stage/storage table relationship from native water levels; not native stored volume.
Missing native water levels remain null, not dry.
Cell-average depth, not roadway or bridge clearance; no calibrated plus/minus accuracy.
GCN10 derived infiltration database ODbL1.0; attribution and derived database retained.
